config.record_grain: One ASIC Company Dataset row representing a registered or historical company-name record

fields.evidence: ASIC Company Dataset Help File, p.8, data dictionary: “Company Name — Company name as it appears on the register”; header “Company Name”; sample row 2: “LOVINI HOLDINGS PTY LTD”.
ASIC Company Dataset Help File, p.8, data dictionary: “ACN — Australian Company Number”, format 9-digit numerical including leading zeros; sample row 2 header/value: ACN “000000019”.

ASIC Company Dataset Help File, pp.10–11, data dictionary: “ABN — Australian Business Number”; documentation states the field shows the company ABN and shows 0 when there is no ABN; sample row 2 header/value: ABN “89000000019”.

ASIC Company Dataset Help File, p.8, data dictionary: “Type — Specifies the type of company”; documented values include APTY, APUB, FNOS and RACN. Sample rows 2–9 show APTY. Mapping is limited to the explicitly documented type field and does not use a name suffix.

ASIC Company Dataset Help File, pp.9–10, data dictionary: “Status — Status of company”; documented codes include REGD (Registered), DRGD (De-registered), and EXAD (External administration). Sample row 2: Status “REGD”.
ASIC Company Dataset Help File, p.11, data dictionary: “Date of Registration — Date on which a company was registered”, format DD/MM/YYYY; sample row 2: “08/01/1990”.

unmapped_fields.reason: ASIC liability/class code is not represented by the supplied ontology; do not infer entity_type from it.
ASIC company subclass code is not represented by the supplied ontology.
The ontology has no deregistration-date field; it must not be mapped to date_registered.
This is historical state-registration metadata, not an address state.
State registration identifier is not an ACN/ABN and has no corresponding ontology field.
Dataset-change flag has no corresponding ontology field.
Name-history indicator has no corresponding ontology field.

Documentation describes this as a current company name used conditionally for historical records; the ontology does not provide a separate legal-name-history field, and it must not be relabelled as a trading name.
Historical/current-name start date has no corresponding ontology field and is not the company registration date.

limitations: The source is a weekly snapshot and documentation warns it may not be accurate at query time; publication_proxy is used from the source envelope (2026-09-14T14:53:34.014830), not a row-change timestamp.
Company Name rows include historical name records and repeated ACNs; ingestion preserves rows and does not reconcile names or assign historical names as trading names.
The ACN field is documented to contain an ARBN when Type=RACN; the acn operation validates the supplied value but does not resolve that qualification.
ABN and ACN are independently validated with their dedicated operations; no ABN suffix is used to derive an ACN, and zero/missing invalid values emit no identifier observation.
Status is a register status, not proof of operational activity; deregistration status is not inferred from any licence event.
No address, website, industry code, branch, licence, trading-name ownership, or reporting-group relationship is evidenced by this source.
Authority, field, and linking scores are provisional and require human review.
